classification.difficultyReason: Recognise a letter containing both parallel and perpendicular strokes.

content.prompt: Look at the letters below. Which one has both parallel and perpendicular lines?

spec.sourceRegion: Question 7, centered letter row below the stem
spec.description: Bold black sans-serif uppercase A C E L Z, in one centered row. Their visible stroke relationships are the mathematical evidence.
spec.mathematics: E has three mutually parallel horizontal strokes, each perpendicular to its vertical stroke. Preserve curved C, diagonal A and Z strokes, and the right angle in L.
spec.answerVisibility: All five options are permanently visible. The supplied answer E is excluded.

answer.worked: The three horizontal strokes are parallel to one another and meet the vertical stroke at right angles. Correct answer: E.
